description: scores/saves/<slot_id>.json (gitignored runtime save-slot body; no data/ content file pairs with this schema - validate_data skips data/schemas/). Written ONLY by game/core/savegame.py through engine.data_io.write_validated. The 'run_state', 'session', 'tile_map' and 'buildings' sub-objects are intentionally loose placeholders as of SaveGamePLAN SG-1 - SG-2/SG-3/SG-4 each tighten their own node in place as they land, per that plan's phased build order.

buildings.description: One entry per live building at save time, via game/buildings/registry.py::save_building. Placeholder item shape as of SG-1 - SG-3 defines the real item schema here.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this slot was created (the autosave that wrote it).

map_id.description: The active map this run was played on.

pinned.description: True if this slot is exempt from FIFO eviction.

round_num.description: The round this save was taken at - always a multiple of 5 in practice (the autosave cadence). Duplicated from run_state.round_num so the index can show it without loading the full body.

run_state.description: RunState.to_dict() output. Placeholder shape as of SG-1 - SG-2 defines its real properties/required list here.

session.description: Session-level save fields (e.g. combat_speed_idx). Placeholder shape as of SG-1 - SG-2 defines its real properties/required list here.

slot_id.description: Unique id; also the stem of this file's own path, scores/saves/<slot_id>.json.

tile_map.description: TileMap.save_state() output. Placeholder shape as of SG-1 - SG-4 defines its real properties/required list here.

unlocked_tiles.description: Every unlocked (BUILDABLE or BUILT) tile's [col, row] at save time - the minimap source (D4: no image bytes stored). Duplicated from tile_map for the same reason as round_num.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write - equals created_at, since a slot is never overwritten by a later autosave (D3: every autosave creates a new slot).

version.description: Document format version. Only 1 exists; a future bump is a schema change.

title: savegame
